```{r setup}
library(PubmedPlot)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
```


```{r}
data(mr_pubmed, package = "PubmedPlot")
b <- group_by_time_interval(mr_pubmed)
p <- plot_time_interval(b)
```


```{r, mr_fig, fig.width=8, fig.height=4, fig.alt = 'Joined scatter plot of the number of new PubMed entries per week containing Mendelian randomis/zation in the title.'}
p
```
